description: This file implements functions and classes related to calculating instance numbers based on command-line flags or global gflags settings. It includes parsing of flags for base instance number, number of instances, and specific instance numbers, and provides methods to compute the final list of instance numbers.

classes.name: InstanceNumsCalculator
classes.description: A class that calculates a list of instance numbers based on command-line flags or global gflags settings.

methods.name: FromFlags
methods.description: Initializes an InstanceNumsCalculator object from a list of command-line flags.

methods.name: FromGlobalGflags
methods.description: Initializes an InstanceNumsCalculator object from global gflags.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Calculates the list of instance numbers based on the current configuration.
